title: Cao Kinderopvang 2025-2026, article 6.2 work-hour premium

excludedSalaryScales.reason: Article 6.2(3) excludes employees assigned to salary scale 11 or higher.

excludedRoleAndSchedule.condition: The employee always works outside the time periods in article 6.2(1) and works in a supporting role outside the primary childcare process.

calculationBase.maximumBasis: Hourly salary for the employee's applicable salary number 18 on the applicable version date.

assignmentInputsToVerify: Employer-instructed work hours and the applicable day/time window.
Employee salary scale (must be below scale 11).
Employee role and whether it is in the primary childcare process.
The scale's salary-number-18 hourly rate for the applicable date.
